items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
items.summary: Overseas firms serving UK retail customers need authorization too, and nobody trades under the new rules before October 2027.
